rules.description: Electrical wiring, exposed wires, breakers, outlets, and ceiling fan work can create shock or fire risk.
rules.warning: Switch off power at the breaker and verify the circuit with a voltage tester before touching any wiring.

rules.description: Main panel or service panel work exposes users to high-current electrical hazards.
rules.warning: Do not open or modify the main electrical panel unless you are licensed and authorized.

rules.description: Gas line work can cause fire, explosion, poisoning, or code violations.
rules.warning: Leave the area and contact emergency services or a licensed gas technician if a gas leak is suspected.

rules.description: Load-bearing walls, beams, foundations, and support columns require structural assessment.
rules.warning: Do not alter structural elements without approval from a qualified structural engineer.

rules.description: Wall demolition can involve structure, hidden utilities, dust, and permit requirements.
rules.warning: Confirm the wall is non-load-bearing and scan for hidden electrical, plumbing, or gas services before demolition.

rules.description: Roof repair adds fall risk and weather exposure.
rules.warning: Avoid roof work without proper access, dry conditions, and fall protection.

rules.description: Active leaks can damage structures and create electrical hazards.
rules.warning: Shut off the water supply and keep water away from electrical outlets and appliances.
